name: Band Pull-Apart

instructions.description: Stand tall holding a resistance band at shoulder height with both arms extended.
Brace your trunk and keep the ribs from flaring.
Pull the band apart by moving the arms outward and squeezing the shoulder blades gently together.
Return slowly to the start without snapping the band.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a light band that allows precise scapular control.

variations.variationDescription: Targets similar upper-back muscles with straighter elbows and less arm flexion.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use supported upward arm motion to reinforce posture and shoulder mechanics.

commentsNotes: Do not hyperextend the lower back.
